Heritage of Excellence Since 1998

About ARROW ARO RICE

From the fertile plains of the Himalayan river basins to dining tables across the globe, delivering the pinnacle of Indian Basmati and Non-Basmati rice with uncompromised integrity.

Company Overview

India's Premier Rice Milling & Star Export House

ARROW ARO RICE EXPORTS PVT LTD was founded in Taraori, Karnal (Haryana) — the epicentre of world-renowned Indian Basmati cultivation. Over the last two decades, the company has transformed from a regional paddy milling operation into a globally recognized star export powerhouse supplying premier importers, hypermarket chains, and food distributors across 45+ countries.

Our operations encompass direct contract farmer procurement, automated parboiling and steam aging facilities, high-precision Buhler optical color sorting, temperature-controlled warehousing, and port-adjacent export logistics hubs at Mundra Port (Gujarat) and JNPT (Mumbai).

Our Core Pillars

Our Mission

To deliver authentic, wholesome, sortex-clean Indian rice varieties to global dining tables while elevating farmer livelihoods and maintaining exemplary international food safety compliance.

Our Vision

To be the world’s most trusted and technologically advanced agricultural commodity export partner, celebrated for supreme grain quality, transparent trade execution, and punctual maritime delivery.

Export Integrity

Every grain is verified for minimum length, allowable broken percentage, and zero chemical adulteration with mandatory third-party container inspection (SGS/BV) before shipment.

Technological Supremacy

World-Class Processing Infrastructure

Our fully automated manufacturing complex in Taraori, Karnal operates without manual touch to ensure zero contamination.

Buhler Sortex Optical Color Sorters

Automated Zero-Touch Milling & Grading Complex

Taraori, Karnal Facility • 100,000 grains scanned per second • 99.8% Sortex Purity Guarantee

Automated Steam & Parboiling Plants

Advanced stainless steel autoclaves and steam boilers lock essential vitamins and minerals into the starch matrix of each grain, producing consistent Golden Sella and Creamy Sella grades.

Buhler Optical Color Sorters

Ultra-high-resolution cameras scan 100,000 grains per second, instantly ejecting discolored, immature, chalky, or damaged grains to achieve 99.8% pure sortex output.

Moisture-Controlled Silo Warehouses

45,000 MT capacity temperature-regulated silos and dehumidified godowns in Karnal, Mundra Port, and JNPT Mumbai prevent pest infestation and preserve natural Basmati aroma oils.
